stories.title: Kelly Clarkson's "Pretty Woman" feud with a Brooklyn toy shop
stories.summary: Kelly Clarkson told her 8.8 million X followers that the Brooklyn shop Art of Play treated her like Julia Roberts in Pretty Woman, saying a clerk assumed she couldn't afford something. The store replied that she had asked to buy "Molly," a one-of-a-kind singing bird automaton bolted to the wall and not for sale, and Clarkson fired back, "So you're not only rude, you're also a liar." The back-and-forth split the internet between the star and the small business.
